steps.en: Install the pack onto your coding agent
steps.zh: 把技能包装进你的 coding agent

steps.en: Six skills register with the loader and activate on matching prompts
steps.zh: 六个技能经加载器注册，在匹配的提示词上自动激活

steps.en: Ask for an audit in plain language
steps.zh: 用自然语言提出审计要求
steps.code: Audit this page for web quality issues

steps.en: The audit skill seeks live evidence first: Lighthouse and traces via Chrome DevTools MCP, CrUX field data
steps.zh: 先经 DevTools MCP 拿 Lighthouse 实验室实测证据

steps.en: Keeps measured failures apart from source hypotheses, ranks findings against CWV/WCAG/SEO thresholds
steps.zh: 区分实测失败与源码推测，按 CWV/WCAG/SEO 阈值排序结论

value.en: Evidence-led web-quality audits without hand-pasting the checklist, with Lighthouse CLI and static inspection as fallback when no browser tool is wired
value.zh: 不必手贴清单就能得到以证据为准的 web 质量审计；没接浏览器工具时退回 Lighthouse CLI 与静态检查
